CustomField.description: If number of days exceeds 1 year, show in terms of years and months with days as decimal. If number of days is below 1 year, show in terms of days
CustomField.formula: IF( Funding__r.Opportunity__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_MLP', "10 years", IF( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Frequency__c, 'Daily'), IF( ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) <= 365, TEXT(ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0))&" days", IF( ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) >= 730, TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) / 365)) & " years " & TEXT(ROUND(((ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) - 730) / 30.4),2)) & " months", IF( ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) > 365, TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) / 365)) & " year " & TEXT(ROUND(((ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) - 365) / 30.4),2)) & " months", "" ) ) ), IF( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Frequency__c, 'Weekly'), IF( ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) <= 365, TEXT(ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0))&" days", IF( ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) >= 730, TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) / 365)) & " years " & TEXT(ROUND(((ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) - 730)/ 30.4), 2)) & " months", IF( ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) > 365, TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) / 365)) & " year " & TEXT(ROUND(((ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) - 365)/ 30.4), 2)) & " months", "" ) ) ), "" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Text formatted for use in TIL merge documents
CustomField.label: Term (Formatted)
